body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-11-07 (Q2FY26 concall transcript): "Our internal aspiration is that long term, we should be having an order mix of 50-50 ... But I think it will take us at least 2, 3 years to get there." Metric: Export share of order book. Target: ~50% (25% developed, 25% developing markets). Deadline: FY28 (2-3 yrs from Nov-2025; 'at least'). Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: moved-goalpost. Evidence: Next call (Jan-26): 'difficult for me to put in a timeline'. Apr-26: 'about 25% and then eventually 50%'. Aug-26: 'I can't say by when'. Export share of order book was 10% (Mar-26), 17% (Sep-26).
